entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There! That's Takeo Saburi!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: According to the info we have...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "When submitting a complaint, he just says[n]the effectiveness depends on the individual,"[n]"Automatic payments"...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "No scientific evidence" and "people[n]recovered from sickness on their own"...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Those are our four pieces of evidence![n]Let's change his heart!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Takeo Saburi, yes? We're the Phantom[n]Thieves.

entries.speaker: Takeo Saburi
entries.en: Where'd you kids come from? You're young[n]and healthy... Bring me your sick relatives.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Your product, "Miracle X"... Can you explain[n]to us how it's not a fraud?

entries.speaker: Takeo Saburi
entries.en: How dare you accuse me of fraud! I won't[n]let you sabotage my business!

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Like you said, I didn't start calling it a miracle[n]until later on...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But the products are still healthy, right?[n]Why did you make this mistake?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: My parents were fooled by a scam, so I[n]thought I should do it too.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: And when I added materials that were[n]unfamiliar in Japan, everyone believed[n]me...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You should have promoted it as normal[n]health drink instead of saying it could[n]"cure anything."

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Food isn't just a way to gain nutrition.[n]It can also put a smile on people's faces.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Weren't you happy to hear that people's[n]illnesses got better?

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Yes... I had forgotten the true meaning of[n]selling food products...

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Phantom Thieves, please clean my tainted[n]heart...
As you wish.
We'll cure you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Saburi
entries.en: Thank you... I'm glad I realized my mistake...
